content.short: PandaTool provides a visual interface to create and manage their own cryptocurrencies.
content.description: PandaTool provides a no-code visual interface that lets you create and manage your own cryptocurrencies across multiple chains—including BNB Chain, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Multichain, Solana, Polygon and Avalanche—without writing any code. It also includes practical features like cross-chain instant swaps, batch transfers, batch account generation, and market-value management. Looking ahead, PandaTool plans token pre-sales, token locking and unlocking, contract auditing, and other services to support deployment and ongoing management of digital assets.
